text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Waaah, as expected of the Kashiwa Kinen! 
The gathering of spirit is on a whole 
'nother level!☆

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
So many people even in the paddock...! 
This is a GⅠ... If only I could run in one 
someday...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With Copano Rickey is Hokko Tarumae. She's 
a local idol Umamusume dedicated to 
promoting her hometown of Tomakomai.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"It's not 'if' you can run, you WILL run, 
Tarumae! That's why we prepare—so the 
stage is ready."

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Well then, Acute-san, please lead our 
study session today!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Please teach me! The proper mindset when 
standing in the paddock!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Yes, of course, if my wisdom can be of any 
help.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Now, both of you—

text_block_list.name: Funabashi Cheering Squad
text_block_list.text: Funabashiii!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"...Let's make sure to watch closely. At 
the core that takes root in a person's 
heart... the pillar of their 'way of 
life.'"

text_block_list.name: Funabashi Cheering Squad
text_block_list.text: Funabashiiiii! Furiosooooo!

text_block_list.name: Funabashi Umamusumes
text_block_list.text:
"Go, go! Furi-pyon!" "Remember all those 
days of hard training with us!"

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Yes. I will win. Because I am... reborn.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah, you've changed.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
“Still, I ain't gonna change. Even if 
everyone turns their backs on my 'style,' 
I'll keep doing it.”

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: ...Espo-san.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Too bad for you, Furioso. The one winning 
today—is ME!!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Only those who know weakness can reach 
true strength. That is my answer.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: I know.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"It's just that you and I found different 
answers, that's all."

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: ...I shall give it my all.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Bring it on. I'll charge right in at 
full throttle, too.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"There's no such thing as a limit to 
strength! —Let's run, Furioso!"
